summary: Iteration 21 — verified Edit AWB selling fix (charter vs per-kg) end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest pass. Frontend: Per-Kg and Charter save flows + auto-detect charter on re-open all verified with live PATCH response capture. Regression iter20 pytest: 11/11 pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Recap.js openEdit() line 170 auto-detect heuristic (looksCharter = total_tariff>0 && qty_kg==0 && tariff_per_kg==0) works, but if a future user-edit ever zeros out tariff and qty while leaving total_tariff stale before the recompute path runs, the modal could mis-classify. Safer to rely solely on r.is_charter once backend reliably sets it; the qty/tariff fallback should be a one-time migration-only hint.

Recap.js saveEdit() line 213 deletes payload.charter_amount when switching to per-kg, but does NOT explicitly send is_charter=false to overwrite a previously charter document. Server merges via raw model_dump (only non-None), so passing is_charter=false (boolean) is honored — verified by Playwright test. Just call out as a footgun if pydantic strictness ever changes.

server.py line 4057-4071 recompute block uses raw `o.get('addons_total')` rather than recalculating from polis/insurance/spsi/forklift component fields. If addons_total drifts (e.g. polis_amount changed but addons_total not updated), grand_total will be wrong. Consider recomputing addons_total from components in the PATCH path too.

AwbExtendedUpdate (line 4023-4027) accepts insurance_enabled, polis_amount, insurance_amount but the recompute block never recalculates addons_total when these change — only the /receive endpoint updates addons_total. So editing polis via /extended silently drops to old addons_total. Recommend either: (a) reject these fields in /extended, or (b) recompute addons_total when any addon field is in payload.
server.py grew to 8347 lines — splitting modules already flagged in iter20. No regression but no progress either.

rca of the issue: ORIGINAL BUG: Edit AWB modal didn't expose is_charter / charter_amount fields — only tariff/qty, so charter AWBs showed 0/0 in those fields and saving overwrote charter_amount with 0. FIX (verified working): Recap.js openEdit() now auto-detects charter via (is_charter || (total_tariff>0 && qty_kg==0 && tariff_per_kg==0)) and pre-fills charter_amount. Modal shows toggle [edit-mode-perkg / edit-mode-charter] inside the amber selling section; conditional input rendering shows Tarif/KG+Qty(KG) in per-kg mode or Selling Total(IDR) in charter mode. saveEdit() always sends is_charter; when charter, forces tariff_per_kg=0 and qty_kg=0 and parses charter_amount; when per-kg, deletes charter_amount from payload. Backend PATCH /api/orders/{oid}/extended (server.py line 4057-4071) honors is_charter flag to choose recompute path (charter_amount as total vs tariff*qty), computes tax_amount = total * pct / 100 (selling only, not addons), and grand_total = total + tax + addons_total. Reconciled AWBs re-post sales_accrued journal automatically (line 4077-4091).
